summary: Tested Phase P2(b)+P3: admin auth, gated chapter content, token CRUD, leads regression, and frontend dashboard. 13/15 backend tests passed; 2 rate-limit tests failed due to multi-IP ingress (RCA below). Frontend admin login, dashboard, token generation, revoke badge, and gated chapter page all functional.

minor.issue: Rate limit bucket keyed on request.client.host, but Kubernetes ingress forwards requests through 2+ proxy IPs (10.79.131.92 / 10.79.131.93), so per-IP buckets split and the 5/6-request thresholds are not reached. Fix: read X-Forwarded-For (first hop) instead of request.client.host inside _rate_limit / rate_limit_factory.

issues: Test looked for button text 'Beli Akses Sekarang' / 'Kembali ke Beranda' but inner_text did not match those exact strings (page does show 'Akses Terkunci' heading). Main agent should verify the gated-page CTA button labels match the spec.

action_items: Switch rate-limit IP source from request.client.host to X-Forwarded-For (first IP) so per-IP limits work behind the K8s ingress. Without this, leads/cta/chat/admin-login per-IP limits are effectively halved or doubled depending on proxy rotation.

Verify /bab/2 (no token) renders the exact CTA buttons 'Beli Akses Sekarang' and 'Kembali ke Beranda' as spec'd — current page shows the 'Akses Terkunci' message but button labels could not be matched by automated test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses an in-memory RATE_BUCKETS dict — will not survive worker restarts and is not shared across multiple Uvicorn workers if scaled. Acceptable for MVP, but flag for prod.
ADMIN_TOKENS is in-memory only — all admin sessions invalidate on backend restart. For MVP fine, but a brief note in summary may help.
GET /api/chapters/{n} accepts token as query param (?token=...). This leaks tokens to server access logs and browser history. Consider moving to header for production.
/api/admin/tokens POST does not validate email format (uses plain str, not EmailStr). Minor.
seed_data_creation: Test tokens (chapter='2' for TEST_buyer@example.com, chapter='full' for TEST_full@example.com, plus UI-created TEST_ui@example.com and TEST_uifull@example.com) and TEST_* leads were inserted. TEST_buyer token was revoked. These remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend in-memory rate limit buckets persist across requests within the same Uvicorn process. If a test session triggers the admin-login rate-limit (5/60s), subsequent admin-login attempts (including UI logins) will receive 429 for up to 60s. Run rate-limit tests last and pause ~70s before retrying admin login. The 13 functional backend tests are deterministic and pass cleanly.
rca of the issue: Rate-limit tests (admin-login 6th=429, leads 6th=429) failed because the FastAPI app sits behind a Kubernetes ingress that forwards requests through at least 2 distinct upstream IPs (observed 10.79.131.92 and 10.79.131.93 alternating in supervisor logs). Code uses `request.client.host` which reflects the proxy IP, not the real client IP. Therefore identical client requests get split across two rate-limit buckets, halving the effective limit and preventing it from firing in a 6-request burst from a single client. Fix: parse the leftmost IP from request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') and fall back to request.client.host. Apply inside both _rate_limit usages and rate_limit_factory. Once fixed, both test_admin_login_rate_limit and test_leads_rate_limit will pass without other changes.
